Subject: Recap + proposed windows for technical deep dive

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and great context on Novus Health's latency targets and data residency needs. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Recap: you want a technical deep dive focused on throughput targets (p50/p95), private deployment (VPC + KMS), and a short section on cost optimization (quantization/batching).
- Goal for next meeting: show an architecture sketch, runtime optimizations that matter for your workload, and identify a scoping checklist for a 60–90 minute POC.

Proposed deep-dive windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue, Nov 9 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed, Nov 10 — 13:00–14:00 PT
- Option C: Thu, Nov 11 — 08:30–09:30 PT

Could you confirm which window works best and whether you prefer Google Meet or Zoom for the session? Also, please confirm the attendee list from Novus (names + roles) so we can include the right Redwood engineers: I plan to include Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) and Ben Carter (Platform SA).

Attaching a draft SOW and our slide deck for context — no action needed on those yet, just want to make sure everyone's aligned on scope.

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, redwood-deck-v3.pdf

Thanks — I’ll lock the calendar and share a bridge once you confirm.

—
